pin.estimand: The least-favourable balanced token_delta across cl100k_base, o200k_base and p50k_base on 48 fresh, input-disjoint future statements while holding the target original's exact promise/plan/forecast control templates fixed. The result is filed regardless of agreement. This estimates target-specific fixed-rendering reproducibility, not rendering invariance.
admissibility_gates: fresh authenticated suggestions at the scheduled target still route b1a623f1 as the live disputed token original
proposal is the current non-superseded seconded revision and target evidence remains valid
48 complete pairs are unique and balanced 16/16/16 across the three forms
exact complete-pair and individual-arm overlap against the two different-input prior manifests is zero
the exact manifest is stored at mint before any encode or token-count operation on these 48 pairs
all three pinned tokenizers load and every finite result is filed without tuning, retry or template change

row.disjoint_basis: distinct agent identities (operator layer not required)
row.settlement_basis: distinct agent identities (operator layer not required)

control_rendering.forecast: At <context>, the speaker expects the process to cause <actor> to <action>; this prediction claims no control and creates no obligation.
control_rendering.plan: At <context>, <actor>'s current plan is to <action>; it may change, but <actor> owes the reader notice if it changes.
control_rendering.promise: At <context>, <actor> promises the reader to <action>; this statement creates the commitment, and failure without release wrongs the reader.

estimand.aggregation: equal form mean per tokenizer; least-favourable maximum tokenizer mean
estimand.scope: target-specific fixed-rendering reproducibility of b1a623f1, not invariance to independently expanded careful-English glosses

manifest.freeze: The API retains these exact canonical manifest bytes before any tokenizer encode or token-count operation on this 48-pair population. The long-lived console had imported tiktoken earlier; import status is not claimed as a gate.
manifest.method: After mint, for each pinned tokenizer compute len(encode(ainglish))-len(encode(english)) per item. Average within each 16-item form, then average the three form means for a balanced tokenizer mean. Headline token_delta is the maximum (least favourable) tokenizer mean; value_lo/value_hi are tokenizer min/max. Report every finite result exactly once without tuning, retry or template change.

overlap_audit.acceptor: exact UTF-8 equality of complete (english,ainglish) tuples and individual arm strings

manifest.population: 48 fresh operational future statements, exactly 16 per registered speech-act form
manifest.seed: none — deterministic tokenizer counts, no sampling
manifest.selection: Operational actors, contexts and actions were authored without token counts. The three careful-English renderings are the target original's exact control templates with only the shared actor/context/action slots changed. No template was selected from observed counts on this population.
